text: High radial vibration above 7.1 mm/s RMS per ISO 10816-3 on a Class III medium machine indicates bearing wear, rotor imbalance, or shaft misalignment. SOP: shut down within 4 hours; replace SKF 6312 bearing; re-balance rotor to G2.5.

Motor winding temperature above 130 deg C (Class B insulation limit) suggests cooling-loop degradation or overload. SOP: throttle load by 20 percent, verify cooling water flow above 12 L/min, schedule winding insulation resistance test within 48 hours.

Iron-particle count above 200 ppm in lubricating oil indicates pitting on gear flanks. SOP: collect oil sample for ferrography, schedule gearbox inspection at next planned shutdown, increase monitoring frequency to once per shift.

Sideband frequencies at gear-mesh frequency plus or minus shaft frequency indicate eccentric gear or backlash. SOP: tighten coupling bolts to 220 Nm, re-check alignment with laser tool, replace input pinion if sidebands persist.

Cooling water flow below 8 L/min on the primary loop will cause downstream motor temperature rise within 90 seconds. SOP: switch to redundant pump P-102B, backflush strainer S-101, check inlet valve V-12 actuator.

Cooling loop pressure drop above 2.5 bar from baseline suggests clogged heat exchanger. SOP: schedule CIP (clean-in-place) cycle, inspect plate-pack gaskets, verify upstream filter delta-P below 0.4 bar.
Per UCI AI4I 2020, tool wear above 200 minutes correlates with Tool Wear Failure (TWF). SOP: schedule planned tool change at next product changeover; do not exceed 240 min under any condition.
Per UCI AI4I 2020, mechanical power outside the 3500-9000 W band triggers Power Failure (PWF). SOP: verify torque sensor calibration, check process setpoint, inspect drive coupling for slip.

Per UCI AI4I 2020, Heat Dissipation Failure (HDF) occurs when process-air temperature difference is below 8.6 K and rotational speed is below 1380 rpm. SOP: open bypass damper, increase fan VFD setpoint, log event for reliability review.

Per UCI AI4I 2020, Overstrain Failure (OSF) is triggered when tool wear times torque exceeds 11000 (L), 12000 (M), or 13000 (H) Nm-min. SOP: reduce torque setpoint by 15 percent, replace tool, run a confirmation cycle at half-load.

Gearbox failures in the hot-strip mill propagate to the downstream coiler within 4-6 minutes due to torque spike on the drive train. Always isolate the gearbox electrically before troubleshooting; never restart without checking coupling integrity.

Cooling-loop loss propagates to motor winding overheating within 90 seconds and gearbox oil viscosity drop within 6 minutes. SOP: trigger MOTOR and GEARBOX inspection alarms simultaneously; do not silence cascade alerts.

Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation via Random Forest regression on degradation features (vibration trend, temperature drift, particle count) typically achieves MAE of 8-12 hours on rotating equipment. Always report the 90 percent confidence interval to the planner.

Maintenance Priority Index (MPI) combines anomaly severity, RUL urgency, downtime cost per hour, and spare-parts lead-time. A spare not on hand multiplies MPI by 1.6 to reflect procurement risk. MPI above 75 requires plant-manager sign-off.

Tata Steel reliability standard for hot-strip mill auxiliaries mandates that any critical alarm with confidence above 0.85 must trigger a digital work-order within 15 minutes, with auditable decision trace and role-based notification to Operator, Maintenance, and Reliability Engineer.
